findings: The retry plan records the required not-before time but omits the policy's hard no-later-than deadline of 2026-08-29T20:20:00.000Z. As written, it permits retries after the authorized window.

The separate fact-path acceptance conditions do not explicitly require generation, digest, and complete status to be supplied by one matching confirmation occurrence per replica. That can allow cross-observation fact mixing, contrary to the requirement that manifest and replica confirmations bind the same release occurrence.
summary: Retrying and preserving the unpublished release are supported by the fresh manifest and east confirmation, while west mismatches. The retry plan needs a deadline and occurrence-binding safeguard.
